title: Podkletnov's impulse gravitational generator
summary: Salvatore Pais tells of Podkletnov's impulse gravitational generator, about unspecified at Russia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I believe if Glennov has hit on something already and if it's true that he has made this impulse gravitational generator.

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on unusual propulsion ideas, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a Russian scientist named Eugene Podkletnov. Pais says that if it is true Podkletnov has built an "impulse gravitational generator," a device said to fire off a pulse of gravity-like force, then Podkletnov may already have hit on something real, which would point toward new ways to move through space.
